STARLANE ROGUE - a Freelancer-style space roguelite
====================================================

Double-click StarlaneRogue.exe to play. No install needed.

If you get a black screen or an error about Vulkan, use
"Play (compatibility mode).bat" instead.

Windows may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher (it isn't
code-signed). Click "More info" then "Run anyway".

CONTROLS
  Mouse ............ steer (Space toggles mouse flight)
  Left mouse ....... fire
  W / S ............ throttle up / down    Backspace: full stop
  Shift+W or C ..... cruise (charges 5 s, then 300 m/s)
  Tab .............. afterburner
  A / D, Q / E ..... strafe, roll
  R ................ next target          T: tractor in loot
  F ................ dock / investigate / enter a trade lane
  M ................ nav map (click a sector to set a waypoint)
  G ................ autopilot to the waypoint
  J ................ journal (objectives and contracts)
  I ................ cargo & loadout      Esc: pause

Your mission: carry the Gatebreaker core to the jump gate at the far east
edge of the system. Stations have Mission Boards with paid contracts.
Watch your speed near rocks and other ships: collisions hurt.

Fly through trade lane rings to travel fast. Jammers (red bubbles)
block cruise and lanes until you destroy them. Reach the Warlord's
Bastion on the far east side, destroy the dreadnought, and escape.

Your progress between runs (salvage, upgrades, ships) is saved in
%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Starlane Rogue\
